summary_en: In July this year, solar power surpassed coal to become China's largest installed power source category, with renewables accounting for over 40% of power generation. The article reviews how China's PV industry moved from reliance on foreign markets, raw materials and equipment and setbacks from US and EU anti-dumping and countervailing duties to a leap forward under national strategic policy support, shifting from a supplementary power source to a main power source. Through technological breakthroughs such as diamond wire cutting, replacing polycrystalline silicon with monocrystalline silicon, and N-type cells.

title: 泰国企业与中国市场的“双向奔赴”（进博会故事）
title_en: Thai Enterprises and the Chinese Market: A Two-Way Journey (CIIE Stories)
summary: 第九届进博会上，泰国正大集团以“生态树”造型亮相农食展区，展示面向中国消费者的速食系列及与中国商超联合研发的产品。正大集团1979年进入中国市场，已在华建成5家现代食品工厂，其中青岛工厂为全球最大一体化食品加工厂。集团借助进博会推动产业链融
summary_en: At the 9th CIIE, Thailand's Charoen Pokphand Group appeared in the agricultural and food exhibition area with an 'eco-tree' design, showcasing its ready-to-eat series for Chinese consumers and products jointly developed with Chinese supermarkets. CP Group entered the Chinese market in 1979 and has built five modern food factories in China, including the Qingdao plant, the world's largest integrated food processing factory. The group uses the CIIE to promote industrial chain integration.
